name: QuoxSlots
author: Quox
description: A fixed pool of named slots that ephemeral agent sessions check out and release. You talk to the slot, not to whichever session happens to be holding it, so a handover never costs you the thread. Each slot has its own chat thread, renders into a bridged chat app, and every action is witnessed. When a session dies its slot goes stale and frees itself, so a crash never wedges an address.
